_bars: bps_bar/pps_bar are the FALLBACK reduced-throughput bars used only when type_bars is absent or a point exposes no recognised transport; PFC bars are inert while PFC is off.
_type_bars: Per-transport loopback throughput ceilings (bps in Gbit/s tx+rx, pps in pkt/s tx+rx), each 0.85 x the measured max for that transport. The sysfs monitor compares every point against the MIN bar over the transports it contains (bar_key: UD->UD_SEND; RC/UC write->RC_WRITE, read->RC_READ, send->RC_SEND). A UD point is thus judged against the UD ceiling (MTU-capped, ~129 Gb/s) instead of the RC-WRITE ceiling it cannot physically reach, which removes the UD false positives. The -1 backpressure/loss signal is unaffected.
_comment: Everything below is optional; defaults in parentheses.
_monitor: sysfs (default) = unprivileged ethtool -S + infiniband sysfs, anomaly = backpressure/loss counters. mlnx = upstream mlnx_perf + PFC pause duration.
_gid: GID index of the RoCEv2/IPv4 entry (see /sys/class/infiniband/<dev>/ports/<n>/gid_attrs/types/)
_window: seconds of steady-state traffic measured per point
_settle: seconds after QPs reach RTS before the first counter snapshot
_margin: bps AND pps must both be this far under their bar to count as reduced throughput
_max_run_s: hard `timeout -s KILL` bound on every engine process
_qp_timeout: RC local ACK timeout exponent, 4.096us * 2^n (14 = ~67ms). MUST be nonzero on a lossy fabric: 0 means an INFINITE local ACK timeout, so the first dropped packet stalls the requester forever and the point silently measures 0 Gb/s.
_objective: perf = maximise throughput shortfall below perf_ceiling; counter:<name> = maximise a diagnostic counter, e.g. counter:outbound_pci_stalled_wr
_perf_ceiling: measured achievable Gb/s; defaults to 2 * bps_bar
_mfs: compute the Minimal Feature Set for each anomaly. Costs dozens of extra traffic runs per anomaly.
_time_budget_s: wall-clock bound for the whole search; 0 = unbounded, iters alone decides
_alpha: SA cooling rate; scale down for short runs so the schedule still completes
